title: Inline rename/delete controls for category badges in filter bar

requirements.summary: Add rename and delete actions directly on each category badge in the filter bar under Favorites.
acceptanceCriteria: When categories are visible under the Favorites control, the user can initiate rename and delete actions from that same area (without needing to navigate elsewhere).
Rename and delete actions are available for each category shown in the filter bar.

file_operations.description: Enhance the category badges row to include per-category edit (rename) and delete affordances directly in the badge area (e.g., small icon buttons visible on hover/focus), while preserving the existing click-to-filter behavior. Use existing shadcn-ui primitives already used in the app (e.g., Button/Badge/ScrollArea + Dialog/Input for rename, and ConfirmDialog for delete confirmation) and ensure edit/delete clicks do not trigger category selection. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Wire CategoryFilterBar’s new rename/delete flows into the app state by passing callbacks that can update/clear the currently selected category filter when a rename or delete occurs from the filter bar.

requirements.summary: Support name-only category renames and keep prompts and category list consistent after rename, including clean filter selection transitions.
acceptanceCriteria: Renaming a category changes only its name (no other prompt fields are modified).
After rename completes, prompts that previously contained the old category name now contain the new category name.
After rename completes, the old category no longer appears in the categories list and the new category does appear.
If the renamed category was currently selected as a filter, the UI transitions cleanly (e.g., selection updates to the new name or clears selection) without errors.

file_operations.description: Add an API wrapper for the backend capability that performs a category rename (e.g., a method that invokes the backend’s category-name update function), keeping the existing category ID mapping behavior consistent with the rest of the app.

Update the renameCategory action to persist renames end-to-end using the dedicated backend rename capability when available, and ensure local prompt updates only change the category name values (no other prompt fields). Keep local categories/prompt stores in sync after rename completes.
Ensure that when a renamed category was selected as the active filter, the selectedCategory state updates to the new name (or clears if appropriate) to avoid stale selection and UI errors.

Constrain the rename UI to name-only editing (single text input), validate trimmed non-empty values, and invoke the sync hook rename action. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Delete categories from the filter bar while detaching them from prompts and clearing active category filters when needed.
acceptanceCriteria: Deleting a category does not delete any prompts.
After deletion, prompts that had the deleted category no longer include it in their categories list.
After deletion, the category no longer appears in the categories list (including the filter bar).
If the deleted category was currently selected as a filter, the selection is cleared automatically.

file_operations.description: Harden the deleteCategory action to ensure prompts are preserved while only removing the deleted category from each prompt’s categories list locally after the backend operation completes; keep categories store updated so the filter bar no longer shows the deleted category.
When a category is deleted via the filter bar controls, automatically clear selectedCategory if it matches the deleted category to prevent a stale active filter.

Add a delete confirmation flow for each category in the filter bar (reusing the existing ConfirmDialog pattern) and invoke the sync hook delete action. Ensure deleting from the badge area does not navigate or require opening a separate management screen. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
